title: I built a drone with only one motor [video]
why_read: A single-motor drone is a neat mechanical engineering demo but mostly a fun build log rather than deep technical content.
analysis: Most drones use four or more motors for stability and control; building one with a single motor requires creative control schemes, likely using control surfaces, variable pitch, or asymmetric thrust vectoring for stabilization. This is an interesting hobbyist engineering challenge showing how far minimal-actuator designs can go. It's more of a fun video demo than a paper, so the depth is limited to what's shown.
